categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Haitian Ruisheng Science Technology Ltd. primarily operates in AI training data research, design, production, and sales. Its core business segments include intelligent speech, computer vision, natural language processing, and related application services. The company serves various innovative application scenarios such as intelligent driving, human-computer interaction, content generation, smart home, smart cities, intelligent security, and more.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI algorithms, integrated data processing platforms, and multi-modal data collection and annotation technologies. It employs proprietary technologies in speech recognition, speech synthesis, computer vision, and natural language processing, supported by a comprehensive data processing platform that automates and enhances data annotation efficiency. The production process includes dataset design, raw data collection, data annotation, and quality control, with strong emphasis on multi-language and multi-modal data capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haitian Ruisheng serves over 930 customers globally, including major technology companies such as Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu, iFlytek, Hikvision, ByteDance, Microsoft, Amazon, and Samsung, as well as research institutions like the Chinese Academy of Sciences and Tsinghua University. Its markets span technology internet, social media, IoT, intelligent driving, smart finance, education, and government sectors, providing training data for AI algorithm development and model training.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas business, including subsidiaries in Hong Kong and the United States. Its overseas customers are mainly in the US, South Korea, Japan, and other regions. Despite a decline in overseas revenue in 2023 due to regulatory and market challenges, the company is actively expanding its global footprint through enhanced overseas sales teams and participation in international AI conferences.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haitian Ruisheng operates midstream in the AI industry supply chain, focusing on the development and provision of high-quality training datasets essential for AI model training. It sources raw data through partnerships and manages data annotation and processing, serving downstream AI algorithm developers and technology companies. The company also manages a sophisticated supply chain for data collection and annotation services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes a dual-driven strategy of technology and product innovation, focusing on intelligent data processing platforms, multi-modal and multi-language data capabilities, and large model data services. It invests heavily in R&D to enhance AI foundational algorithms, data annotation automation, and data security compliance. Future R&D priorities include expanding intelligent driving data platforms, exploring large model data services, and strengthening data security and compliance frameworks.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through three models: customized training data services where fees are charged per project without IP ownership transfer; sales of standardized training data products with IP licensing allowing multiple sales; and training data-related application services including algorithm model training and software/hardware licensing. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance of data or services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haitian Ruisheng is a leading domestic AI foundational data service provider with strong international competitiveness. It competes with companies like Appen, DataTang, and Biaobei Technology. The company differentiates itself through its comprehensive multi-modal data capabilities, extensive multi-language linguistic research, proprietary data processing platforms, and strong data security compliance, positioning it as a top-tier player in China's AI training data market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 170 million, a 35.33% decline from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to the parent company of RMB 30.39 million. Total assets stood at RMB 824.5 million, and equity attributable to shareholders was RMB 782.3 million. Despite short-term revenue and profit declines due to market and regulatory challenges, the company maintains substantial R&D investment (34.4% of revenue) and is focused on long-term growth through strategic global expansion and new business development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haitian Ruisheng offers high-quality, large-scale, and structured AI training datasets with proprietary intellectual property rights, enabling scalable and repeatable sales. Its unique value lies in comprehensive multi-language and multi-modal data coverage, advanced data processing automation, and strong compliance with data security regulations. The company’s deep linguistic research and patented technologies provide competitive barriers, supporting clients in accelerating AI model development and reducing costs while ensuring data security and regulatory compliance.
